title: Core foundation: board representation, FEN parsing, attack detection, isValidFEN, INITIAL_FEN
Core: inCheck
Core: legalMoves for ordinary moves of every piece, legal only (pins; the king never moves into check). No castling, en passant or promotion yet
Core: legalMoves when the side to move is in check (evasions: king moves, captures of the checker, blocks; double check)
Core: legalMoves with castling (rights, empty squares, no castling out of, through or into check)
Core: legalMoves with promotions (all four pieces, by push and by capture)
Core: legalMoves with en passant (including the rank pin that makes it illegal)
Core: perft (fast enough for the published positions)
Core: normalizeFEN (canonical form, en passant kept only if an ep capture is legal)
Core: applyMove (clocks, castling rights, en passant, normalized output, throws on illegal)
Core: positionStatus (checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, fifty-move rule, precedence)
Core: gameStatus with automatic threefold repetition
Core: timeoutResult (loss on time vs draw when the opponent can't mate)
Core: premoveTargets (empty-board movement, castling by rights, pawn pushes/diagonals)
Notation: toSAN (disambiguation, castling, promotion, +/#)
Notation: fromSAN (tolerant parsing, 0-0, annotations, null on illegal/ambiguous)
Notation: toPGN (seven-tag roster, SetUp/FEN, numbered move text, 1... for Black start)
Notation: parsePGN (comments, NAGs, nested variations, move numbers, first game only)
Engine: bestMove with levels 1-5, alpha-beta + evaluation, seeded randomness, maxTimeMs and level-5 time budget
Engine: levels 2-5 always play mate in 1
Engine: levels 4-5 find mate in 2
Clock: createClock with press/remaining/flagged/pause/resume and increments
Sound: soundFor and a Web Audio play() for every SoundKind
UI: mountApp game screen - board, tap-to-move, targets, last move, status, move list, engine turn with 0.6 s minimum and data-thinking, sound calls
UI: promotion picker, check highlight, game end (checkmate/draws) blocks further moves
UI: flip control toggles board orientation
UI: new-game settings (level, color incl. random, time control) applied on new-game; engine moves first when you're Black
UI: undo (your move + reply, or cancel the pending search), disabled when nothing to undo or in clocked games
UI: clocks for timed games - m:ss / tenths display, data-active, increments, engine maxTimeMs (~remaining/30 + increment), clocks saved with the game
UI: running out of time - Time out / timeout-vs-insufficient-material status, clocks stop, data-thinking cleared
UI: mute toggle with data-muted, remembered in storage
UI: save and restore the game in progress from storage
UI: one premove while the engine thinks (premoveTargets, data-premove, cancel, play-or-cancel on reply)
PWA: index.html (viewport, manifest, apple tags), manifest.webmanifest, generated PNG icons
PWA: public/sw.js caching the built app, registered from src/app
App: entry point (mountApp into the page), engine Web Worker, phone layout; npm run build succeeds
